description.value: Forest Bistro & Lounge is a chef-driven coastal bistro pub in Powell River with panoramic ocean views and a seasonal patio. The kitchen is helmed by John, a classically trained chef whose career spans fine dining, yacht cookery, and award-winning bistro work, now running the restaurant alongside his partner Jessica. Touring cyclists finishing a Sunshine Coast leg will find a full dinner menu with elevated pub fare and a solid drink list.

address.value: 4463 Marine Ave, Powell River, BC V8A 2K3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides address (4463 Marine Ave, Powell River, BC V8A 2K3), phone (604-489-1221), and email. The OSM record lacks these fields so the website is the primary source for contact info. The menu lists several clearly meat-free dishes (Glazed Beet Salad, Ratatouille Chevre Tart, Wild Mushroom Ragout, Baked Squash, Tomato Cucumber Salad) confirming vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi was found on the website.
concerns: OSM record has no address, phone, or email tags — all contact info sourced from website only.
Community assigned as 'Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Powell River is on the Sunshine Coast mainland; may be miscategorized in the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with an active website, full menu, and confirmed contact details. Straightforward include.
